svg.title: ShelfRunner functional decomposition
svg.desc: Black box and connected functional structure for transferring packages to assigned storage locations. Material, energy and signal flows use distinct arrow styles.
svg.text: Net energy to package; dissipated energy
Scope: placement only. If motion is inhibited, the package remains supported within the system; manual recovery is outside this boundary.
Energy losses include heat and sound; net energy to package includes elevation change. No net energy storage assumed per completed cycle.
